# Gate Hypermarket

> Gate Hypermarket is a premier grocery and retail chain operating 4 extensive stores across Dubai and Ajman in the United Arab Emirates. Gate provides fresh produce halls, premium butchery, in-house bakeries, household essentials, and seasonal promotional circulars.

## Quick Facts
- **Country**: United Arab Emirates (UAE)
- **Locations**: Dubai (Al Barsha, Al Quoz, Deira Sabkha) and Ajman (Nuaimiya)
- **Primary Website**: https://www.gateuae.com
- **Customer Service**: 123456789 | gate@gmail.com
- **WhatsApp Support**: 123456789
- **Social Media**:
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gate.albarsha/
  - Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61576920945881
  - TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@gate_albarsha
  - YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@gatedubai
- **Policy**: All promotional discounts and circular specials are valid in-store only.

## Main Pages & Services
- [Store Finder](https://www.gateuae.com/stores): Interactive map and directions for all 4 hypermarket branches in Dubai and Ajman.
- [Current Flyers & Promotions](https://www.gateuae.com/promotions): View this week's digital flyer and seasonal multi-page savings catalogs.
- [Careers & Job Openings](https://www.gateuae.com/careers): Explore full-time, cashier, supervisory, and warehouse retail vacancies.
- [The Gate Journal & Recipes](https://www.gateuae.com/blog): UAE seasonal cooking guides, shopping meal plans, and produce tips.
- [About Gate Hypermarket](https://www.gateuae.com/about): Heritage from one shop in Deira to 4 major UAE branches.
- [Contact Customer Care](https://www.gateuae.com/contact): Inquiries, store feedback, vendor submissions, and branch assistance.
